To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a new predictive CONDENSATION based EigenTracker that can efficiently track objects undergoing simultaneous changes of appearance, and image motion.

(i) we propose a new CONDENSATIONbased predictive EigenTracker that is efficient in tracking objects which undergo image motion and view changes; (ii) our scheme is on line, i.e., the eigenspace is updated on the fly, and the tracker is flexible, it is possible to combine it with other trackers in order to achieve a symbiotic effect.

(1) we have developed the first CONDENSATION based on-line EigenTracker, (2) we have developed an efficient on-line EigenTracker for appearance-based tracking of unknown objects, and (3) our on-line EigenTracker can be used in conjunction with other appearance-based trackers in a symbiosis fashion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new appearance-based tracking algorithm which is capable of handling both the image motions as well motion in appearance of the object being tracked.
the problem of tracking unknown objects.
the development of efficient, robust and flexible on-line appearance-based tracking schemes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we present a framework for on-line appearance based tracking which is efficient, flexible, and robust.
the proposed framework can be used to track objects in a robust and efficient manner.
our on-line EigenTracker can track unknown objects which simultaneously undergo significant image motions and changes in view.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our on-line EigenTracker can track an unknown object in a video sequence with a single appearance model.
we have developed an on-line appearance-based tracking system which is fast, accurate, and robust.
we have developed an on-line appearance-based EigenTracker which uses predictive techniques to enhance its performance and is flexible enough to use in a symbiotic fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple and efficient predictive framework can enhance a basic EigenTracker to handle a wider variety of motions and appearance changes.
the CONDENSATION framework can be successfully applied for appearance-based tracking.
a predictive EigenTracker can efficiently track unknown objects, and is a useful tool for many computer vision applications.
